'''Maccent''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Phelleem sector/Legends|Phelleem sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], along the [[Sisar Run/Legends|Sisar Run]].
